5063536259989.variantName: Height Lighting Tabletop Artificial Christmas Tree with Rustic Log Base LED 60cm
5063536259989.sourceDescription:
Not every room has space for a full-size tree, but every room deserves a bit of Christmas. This little tabletop tree brings all the festive feeling to a sideboard, desk or bedside table, with lush green branches sitting on a rustic log base that gives it a cosy, natural look.

It comes in two heights, 45cm or 60cm, so you can pick the size that fits your space. The branches are full and bushy and can be bent and fluffed out to shape, and the bark-edged log base keeps it steady wherever you put it.

You can also choose whether you want it plain or with warm white LED lights already wrapped through the branches. The lit version glows beautifully in the evening, just like candlelight, and runs on 3 x AAA batteries, which aren’t included, so there are no wires to hide. The plain version is perfect for decorating your own way with mini baubles, ribbon or a little star on top.

It’s lovely on a mantelpiece, windowsill, kitchen worktop or office desk, or in a bedroom, flat or anywhere short on space. Pop a couple of different sizes together for a mini festive forest, and keep it out right through the season.
Small tree height: 45cm
Large tree height: 60cm
Base: Log with bark edge
Lit tree lights: Warm white LED
Lit tree batteries: 3 x AAA (not included)

Handmade detailing contributes to the character of the design. The decorative elements give the product a distinct appearance that can be coordinated with the surrounding arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Product Description
Product Introduction
Spruce up your holiday space with this 4-pack of Christmas cushion covers, featuring warm painterly artwork of Santa, snowmen and reindeer sleighs against rich red winter backdrops. Crafted from durable woven polyester, these pillow covers have a textured
 linen-like touch. The well-printed holiday motifs deliver cozy vintage Christmas vibes to instantly lift your home’s festive feel.
Product Parameters

 Pack: 4 cushion covers (4 assorted designs)
 Dimension: 45 x 45 cm (18 x 18 inch)
 Material: Polyester woven fabric
 Fastener: Hidden zipper
 Important: Pillow inner inserts are not included


Application Scenarios
Ideal seasonal decor for living room sofas, armchairs, bedroom beds and window seats. Fit perfectly for Christmas family gatherings, holiday dinner parties and cottage-style festive styling. They also make a lovely surprise Christmas gift for loved ones.

Notes
Wash separately in cold water by machine on a mild cycle. Avoid bleaching and high-temperature drying. Do not iron directly on the printed pattern. Store in a dry place after holiday use for repeated use year after year.
✅ Premium Polyester Fabric:These Christmas pillow covers are crafted from high-quality polyester fabric, soft, skin-friendly and long-lasting. Wrinkle-resistant and fade-proof, they retain bright colors and sharp printed patterns to bring you lasting festive comfort.
✅ Festive Christmas Home Decor:Set of 4 cushion covers, each measures 17.7 x 17.7 inches. Featuring classic Christmas prints, they easily build up a warm holiday vibe. Great decoration for sofa, living room, bedroom, balcony and more to welcome the festive season.
✅ Hidden Zipper Design & Ideal Holiday Gift:Equipped with invisible zipper for easy insertion and removal of pillow inserts. Smooth zipper brings a neat seamless look. This pillow cover set is a wonderful gift choice for housewarming, Christmas and holiday parties for your family and friends.
✅ Easy to Clean & Maintain:Machine washable in cold water with gentle cycle. Do not bleach; tumble dry on low heat. Note: PILLOW INSERTS ARE NOT INCLUDED. Feel free to reach out to us if you have any questions about your order.
✅ Reusable for Multiple Holiday Seasons:Lightweight and easy to store flat after use, you can reuse them year after year. The widened zipper opening helps you slip the pillow insert in and out quickly for hassle-free seasonal decoration updates.

Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Red and Gold. Quantity: 70 pack.
70-piece festive pack of red and gold plastic baubles for Christmas tree decoration.
Lightweight design makes these ornaments easy to handle, move, and store between seasons.
Includes hanging details for secure positioning on branches or in coordinated seasonal displays.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

1234550002589.sourceDescription:
Keep your Christmas tree secure, upright and beautifully displayed with this durable Green Metal Christmas Tree Stand. Designed to support Christmas trees up to 2.4 metres tall, this sturdy tree holder features a strong star-shaped metal base that provides excellent stability throughout the festive season. The integrated 2-litre water reservoir helps keep your real Christmas tree hydrated and fresh for longer, while four adjustable fixing screws allow you to securely position and stabilise the tree trunk. Made from solid, rust-resistant steel, this reusable Christmas tree base is built for reliable performance and long-lasting seasonal use. Its practical design combines strength, stability and convenience, making it an ideal addition to your Christmas decorations and festive home setup.
HEAVY-DUTY METAL CONSTRUCTION: Made from solid steel with a durable green finish, providing a strong and reliable foundation for your Christmas tree throughout the festive season.
SUITABLE FOR TREES UP TO 2.4M: Designed to accommodate Christmas trees up to 2.4 metres tall, making it suitable for a variety of real Christmas trees in your home.
2-LITRE BUILT-IN WATER RESERVOIR: Features an integrated 2L water tank to help keep real Christmas trees hydrated and maintain their freshness during the festive period.
FOUR ADJUSTABLE FIXING SCREWS: Equipped with four adjustable screws and durable fastening nuts to hold the tree trunk securely in position and help prevent unwanted movement.
STRONG STAR-SHAPED METAL BASE: The sturdy star-shaped support structure provides a balanced foundation, helping keep your Christmas tree upright and stable.
RUST-RESISTANT AND REUSABLE: Manufactured with a durable, rust-resistant finish for dependable seasonal use, allowing you to reuse the stand for Christmas celebrations year after year.
DURABLE ERGONOMIC FIXINGS: Features practical fixing bolts with easy-grip red adjustment knobs for convenient tightening and secure tree positioning.
IDEAL FOR FESTIVE HOME DECOR: A practical Christmas accessory for displaying real Christmas trees in living rooms, hallways and other indoor festive spaces.

5098267293889.sourceDescription:
Snowflake Hanging Decorations

These snowflake hanging decorations are designed to add crystal shaped details to a Christmas display.

Product details
Colour: Blue. Material: acrylic. Decorative theme: Christmas Tree. Supplied quantity: 18 pieces.

The christmas tree motif gives this version its stated festive display theme. The reusable format can be kept for subsequent tasks when cleaned and stored according to its material requirements.

The seasonal format makes the item part of a planned celebration or countdown. The stated contents and design help establish how it will be used, whether it is displayed, opened in sequence or combined with other suitable decorations.

Consider the available display space and the way the item will be accessed during the season. The dimensions and number of elements are useful when arranging a tabletop, shelf or other suitable location.

The selected motif can be coordinated with existing seasonal colours and decorations. Keep the relevant openings, numbered sections or decorative details visible so the arrangement retains its intended appearance and function.

For storage after the occasion, keep reusable pieces together and protect any projecting or easily creased details. Clean the item only by a method suitable for its material and allow it to dry before packing it away.

The product contents should be checked against the stated description before selection. Decorative packaging, display props and additional items are included only where they are expressly identified as part of the set.

Use the item according to its stated age guidance and construction.

Small components and decorative accessories should be handled in the manner specified for the product; a festive appearance alone does not establish suitability for young children.
Add festive charm with these reusable blue snowflake hanging decorations, perfect for Christmas tree displays.
Includes a generous pack of 18 acrylic pieces to create a full and sparkling seasonal display effect.
Crafted from durable acrylic material that is easy to clean and store for reuse in subsequent years.
Features a classic crystal-shaped design that coordinates beautifully with existing festive colour schemes.
Guarantee - 1 month
Shatterproof
Included: 18x snowflake hanging decorations
Hanger included

8956086439789.variantName: 30 Inch White Plush Christmas Tree Skirt 76cm, Sequin Silver Snowflakes, Luxury Faux Fur Tree Mat, New Year Holiday Home Decor
8956086439789.sourceDescription:
A white 76 cm tree skirt with silver snowflakes, for the tree that is meant to look like it grew out of a snowdrift. The plush is soft enough that children sit on it, which is roughly what happens anyway.

Sequin snowflakes are stitched round the hem, so they catch the tree lights without needing a second string. The back is non-woven fabric that blocks needles and sap, and the opening closes with hook-and-loop fasteners so it fits round the stand in seconds. At 76 cm it suits trees from about 3 to 5 ft tall, including the slim ones sold for small rooms.

White on white works with silver, glass and frosted decorations, and it does not fight a pale carpet.

Material: Faux fur with non-woven backing
White 76 cm skirt with silver sequin snowflakes
Suits slim and tabletop trees from 3 to 5 ft
Soft plush top, needle-blocking non-woven back
Fastens round the stand with hook-and-loop
Pale palette for silver, glass and frosted baubles

Tartan Christmas Tree Skirt: This 35-inch skirt showcases a timeless red-green buffalo tartan print with snowflake motifs, mixed-style christmas tree graphics and merry christmas letter print. The classic plaid design brings a strong retro festive atmosphere, perfectly dressing your tree base.

 Premium Material: Made from premium short plush for a soft, cosy feel. The wrapped edge trim secures threads and stops fraying during repeated seasonal use. The split opening has matching red decorative bow ties. Simply lay the cover flat around your tree trunk.

 Base Protection: Collects fallen pine needles, dry twigs, candle wax spills and broken ornament fragments. It hides the unattractive tree stand and prevents carpets, wooden floors and rugs from being scratched by stand corners, keeping the area tidy.

 Multi-Scene Application: Suitable for living rooms, lounges, dining rooms, hallways, apartments, farmhouse interiors, home gatherings, private parties, church decoration and shop window displays. It builds a lovely background for stacking gifts and works as a prop for festive photos and short videos.

 Holiday Gift: A core decor piece for indoor christmas decorations, reusable for many seasons with proper storage. A thoughtful seasonal gift for family, relatives, neighbours and friends for christmas, housewarming and holidays.

5052532160689.sourceDescription:
Christmas Decoration
It adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Quantity: 12 pack.
Pack of 12 festive plastic decorations for versatile home styling.
Designed to create a focal point and enhance your Christmas display details.
Durable plastic material suitable for repeated seasonal use and storage.
Flexible decorative accessory that coordinates with existing room accents.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 12 Christmas decorations

8956086258489.sourceDescription:
This set of 10 candy cane pathway lights comes with festive snowflake toppers, spaced 38 inches apart and standing 21 inches tall once the stake is fitted. Together they form an even, balanced line of light along a path, border or drive, and the classic red and white stripes with snowflake accents give an instantly recognisable Christmas look.

An upgraded high-efficiency solar panel charges the lights through the day for reliable illumination after dark, and USB charging is available as a backup when winter sun is in short supply. A full charge gives roughly 10-12 hours of light, enough to keep the display glowing through the evening. Warm white LEDs cast a soft, inviting glow rather than a harsh glare.

Built from sturdy plastic with premium copper wire, the lights carry an IP44 weather-resistant rating that protects the panel, bulbs and cabling from rain, snow and damp. The removable ground stakes push easily into soil, lawns and flowerbeds, and can be taken out again for flexible positioning, so setting up and rearranging the run takes very little effort.

Suitable for lawns, paths, patios, driveways, borders and front porches, these lights work well for Christmas parties, family gatherings and general seasonal outdoor displays. Store them dry once the season ends and they will be ready to use again next year.
Guarantee - 1 month

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The blue finish and plastic construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Bring the classic charm of a winter woodland directly to your home with the Festive Woodland Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath. Intertwined throughout the realistic branches are 50 warm white LED lights that emit a soft, golden glow. Designed for festive decorating, the lights feature eight different lighting modes so you can easily customise your display, moving from a gentle steady shine to a magical twinkling sparkle. A built-in automatic timer function runs for 6 hours ON and 18 hours OFF, ensuring your home lights up welcomingly every evening while conserving battery life. Durable and built to last, this pre-lit wreath will bring natural beauty and seasonal radiance to your celebrations year after year.

50 warm white LED lights
8 lighting functions
6 hour on/18 hour off timer
Battery operated (requires 6x AA batteries)
Suitable for indoor and outdoor covered use

Christmas Garland
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Dimensions: 30 x 30 x 6 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive red and gold design adds a striking decorative detail to your Christmas display.
Versatile decoration suitable for both indoor and outdoor placement throughout the holiday season.
Compact dimensions of 30 x 30 cm make it an ideal accent piece for mantels, doors or tables.
Crafted from durable plastic material ensuring longevity and easy maintenance year after year.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor & outdoor use
Included: 1x Christmas Garland

Bring a magical winter glow to your home with the Christmas Infinity Light Garland with Snowflakes. Measuring 135cm long, it features 10 snowflakes illuminated by 140 white LEDs.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Product details

Compact dimensions of 64 x 30 x 91.5 cm allow for versatile placement on shelves or mantels.

Simple, elegant design coordinates effortlessly with existing holiday colour schemes and textures.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif for festive display.

Versatile decoration suitable for indoor or outdoor seasonal arrangements.
Easy to reposition and store when not in use.

5051641562889.variantName: 3ft Noble Fir Pot Grown Christmas Tree - Real Live Fresh Living Potted Plant · 本规格 / Selected: 3ft
5051641562889.sourceDescription:
If you're looking for the ideal real Christmas tree, the Noble Fir is up there with the best you can buy. Well known for it's bright green needles that display a bluish-hue with a lovely scent, providing extremely attractive foliage that won't drop it's needles. The hardy upright branches allow for even the heaviest ornaments to be easily supported. Caring for this tree doesn't require much effort, it really only needs water to keep it going, although this will be required often. Make sure when watering that the soil is not waterlogged, and do not allow the container to dry out. Once the christmas period is over, you can transfer the tree into your garden, you can leave it in the container it is supplied in but we recommend you re-pot the tree into a larger pot to accommodate it's growth. The root system that develops within the pot will allow this tree to live for years provided it is given the right level of care. Keep it outside as close to christmas as possible, and when it is time to bring the tree inside, keep it away from sources of heat such as radiators or fireplaces, these will dry the tree out and quickly cause it to drop it's needles. As we ship these staple Trees directly to you from our premesis this guarantees the life and quality of the tree you will receive as you know it won't be bashed around in travel. It's going from us, to you!
PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - GardenersDream Christmas Trees are British grown and cared for year-round by our expert team
REAL LIVING CHRISTMAS TREE - Can be placed outside in the garden after Christmas and can be used repeatedly, eliminating the need to keep buying new trees.
HARDY, ATTRACTIVE FIR - Sports impressive greenish-blue foliage, branches develop upright which helps support heavier ornaments, ideal non-needle drop variety
POT GROWN, EASY TO CARE FOR AND MAINTAIN - With regular watering and occasional feeding, these trees will last a long time. Little pruning is required, just the ocassional trim to keep it's shape
CARE GUIDE SUPPLIED WITH EVERY TREE - Keep your tree in top condition with our free step-by-step care guide. This gives tips on prepping, watering and decorating your tree.
Manufacturer guarantee: Statutory
